notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Othelm.
Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Othelm triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
